en-US.name: Enchanted Spoon
en-US.summary: Add to your Enchanted Spoon shopping list by voice.
en-US.description: Add groceries to your Enchanted Spoon shopping list hands-free, and hear what's on it. Link your Enchanted Spoon account, then say: Alexa, tell Enchanted Spoon to add a gallon of milk. Items are filed under the same categories as the rest of your list, and anything already on it isn't added twice.
examplePhrases: Alexa, tell Enchanted Spoon to add a gallon of milk
Alexa, ask Enchanted Spoon to add eggs and bread
Alexa, ask Enchanted Spoon what's on my shopping list

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Link an Enchanted Spoon account (https://enchantedspoon.app), then say: tell Enchanted Spoon to add a gallon of milk. The item appears on the account's shopping list in the app.
